sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Applicant :-
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Sunil Kumar Singh Hon'ble Rajeev Misra,J.
Heard Mr. Vikas Chauhan, the learned counsel for applicant.
the learned A.G.A. for State opposite party 1 and Mr. Ankaj Kumar Pal, Advocate, holding brief of Mr. Sunil Kumar Singh, the learned counsel representing proseuctrix/first informant/opposite party 2.

Applicant Buddh Sagar, who is a charge sheeted accused, has approached this Court by means of present application under Section 482 Cr. P. C. with the following prayer:-
"It is, therefore, most respectfully prayed that this Hon'ble Court may graciously be pleased to allow this application and quash the entire proceedings of Case No. 37776 Buddh Sagar vs State Of U.P. And Another on 10 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/131311464/
1 of 2024 (State of U.P. Vs. Buddh Sagar) arising out of Case Crime No. 67 of 2024,
under Sections 376, 323, 504 I.P.C., Police Statioon Dubauliya, District Basi pending in the court of Judicial Magistrate-I, Basti and also quashed the Chargesheet dated 25.06.2024 as well as cognizance order dated 18.07.2024 passed by Judicial Magistrate-I, Court No. 12, Basti.
It is, further prayed that this Hon'ble Court may be be pleased to stay the further proceedings of Case No. 37776 of 2024 (State of U.P. Vs. Buddh Sagar) arising out of Case Crime No. 67 of 2024, under Sections 376, 323, 504 I.P.C., Police Statioon Dubauliya, District Basi pending in the court of Judicial Magistrate-I, Basti during the pendency of this application before this Hon'ble Court.

sentences.text: And/or may pass such other and further order as may deem fit and proper under the circumstances of the case, otherwise the applicant shall suffer irreparable loss and injury."
Learned counsel for applicant submits that during pendency of this criminal case, parties amicably settled their dispute outside the Court.
On the basis of settlement arrived at between the parties, a compromise was entered into by the parties.

In view of the compromise entered into by the parties,
a compromise deed was drawn on 16.11.2024.
Photo copy of the same is on record at page 88 of the paper book.
At this juncture, the Court raised a pointed query, as to whether said compromise has been filed before Court below or not?
Learned counsel for applicant fairly submits that the said compromise has not yet been filed before Court below.
In view of above, this application is misconceived at this stage and therefore, liable to be dismissed.

It is, accordingly, dismissed at this stage with liberty to applicant to file a fresh application under Section 482 Cr. P. C. after the compromise entered into by the parties has been duly filed before Court below.
